purpose: Verified contract for determining when investigation runs are duplicates, related, or must remain separate.
core_principle: CASE IDENTITY REQUIRES PROPERTY, TIME, QUESTION AND SCOPE CONSISTENCY WHERE THOSE DIMENSIONS ARE MATERIAL.
duplicate_rule: Runs may be consolidated only where the material identity and scope dimensions are compatible and no unresolved identity conflict exists.
relationship_rule: Related investigations may share evidence references without becoming one legal answer.
historical_rule: Different target dates remain distinct scopes even when the property is identical.
address_rule: An address string alone is not sufficient to establish case identity where multiple properties could match.
conflict_rule: Conflicting material property identifiers prevent automatic merge.
verification_boundary: Case merging determines workflow identity and shared dependencies; it does not establish property facts or legal conclusions.
